page.title: Dental X-ray Decoder
page.seoTitle: Dental X-ray Decoder: Bitewing vs PA vs Panoramic vs CBCT
page.seoDescription: See what bitewings, periapicals, panoramic X-rays and cone-beam CT each show and miss, with real labeled X-rays, radiation doses and typical U.S. prices.

images.title: Bitewing X-ray example
images.alt: Real bitewing X-ray: the crowns of the upper and lower back teeth meeting in the middle, with the bone between the lower teeth at the bottom edge.

images.title: Panoramic dental X-ray example
images.alt: Real panoramic X-ray of an adult: all the upper and lower teeth in one wide image, bright fillings on the back teeth, the sinuses and nose above and the lower jawbone below.
images.caption: Image: "Dental Panorama X-ray" by Farhang Amini, CC BY 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Cropped, converted to grayscale and resized.
